title: Harden deploy-fabric.yml dry-run against fabric-cicd private-API churn once a public resolve-only API exists
description: task-045's dry-run mode enumerates items via fabric-cicd 1.2.0's private _refresh_repository_items/_refresh_deployed_items helpers because the library exposes no public dry-run/resolve-only method. These private entry points may break on a future fabric-cicd upgrade. Track fabric-cicd releases; when a public dry-run or resolve-only API lands, replace the private-helper calls with it and re-validate the workflow's dry-run path. Non-blocking durability hardening, deferred until after task-046 validates the deploy end-to-end.
acceptanceCriteria: Dry-run mode uses only public fabric-cicd API surface (no underscore-prefixed helpers).
Dry-run still resolves and reports what would deploy without publishing.
Workflow YAML remains syntactically valid (actionlint or equivalent).
notes: CREATED 2026-07-30 by /work orchestrator from task-045 implement-agent issues_discovered (non_blocking, suggested_action: create new task).

BLOCKED 2026-08-02 (/work, Erik-approved): acceptance criterion #1 ('Dry-run mode uses only public fabric-cicd API surface, no underscore-prefixed helpers') cannot be satisfied — fabric-cicd 1.2.0 (latest as of 2026-08-02, re-verified locally this session) exposes no public dry-run/resolve-only API. publish_all_items has no dry_run flag; the package has no resolve/preview/plan module; only private _refresh_repository_items/_refresh_deployed_items helpers exist. The task-045 dry-run path therefore cannot be hardened onto a public surface until a future fabric-cicd release ships one. Blocked on an external dependency (a future library release), not on any in-tree work. Revisit when a new fabric-cicd version lands; bump and re-check the public surface.

CLOSED WON'T-DO 2026-08-02 (Erik's call, /work task review). Acceptance criterion 1 is not satisfiable by any in-tree work — it is gated on a fabric-cicd release that may never ship. Holding an unsatisfiable task open would leave the project permanently reading as incomplete for a durability concern that has not actually bitten. Disposition: the constraint is retained as a documented limitation at the call site in .github/workflows/deploy-fabric.yml (private-helper usage + why + the upgrade trigger), so the knowledge survives the task closure and a future fabric-cicd bump has a written trigger to act on. task-045's dry-run path is unchanged and working; nothing is removed.
